Everything your vehicle needs.Handled properly.

From a routine service to the noise you can't place. Tell us what's happening and we'll tell you what it needs, before any work starts.

DemoProposed service structure. Confirm the final list with the workshop.

  • 01 General servicing Minor and major services to manufacturer intervals: oil, filters, fluids and a full safety check. Enquire
  • 02 Brakes & brake systems Pads, discs, drums, callipers and brake fluid. Inspected, measured and replaced only when needed. Enquire
  • 03 Engine diagnostics Warning lights and fault codes read, traced to the cause and explained in plain language. Enquire
  • 04 Suspension & steering Shocks, bushes, ball joints and tie rods for a car that tracks straight and rides quietly. Enquire
  • 05 Auto electrical Batteries, alternators, starters, wiring and lighting faults found and fixed. Enquire
  • 06 Clutch & transmission Slipping clutches, hard gear changes and gearbox noises assessed and repaired. Enquire
  • 07 Engine repairs Timing belts, gaskets, cooling systems and overheating, through to larger mechanical repairs. Enquire
  • 08 Air conditioning Re-gassing, leak checks and component repairs, ready for a Highveld summer. Enquire

Built around your vehicle.Not your invoice.

Most people dread the workshop call because they don't know what they're agreeing to. We work the other way round: you hear what we found, what it costs and what can wait, before a spanner turns.

  1. 01

    Clear communication

    Updates on WhatsApp or by phone while your car is with us. No chasing.

  2. 02

    Honest assessments

    We separate what's urgent from what can wait, so you can plan.

  3. 03

    Quality workmanship

    Careful, methodical work, checked before the keys go back to you.

  4. 04

    Customer-first service

    Practical solutions that fit your car, your budget and your week.
